issue_title: 0i: Emit program C from a selected compiled package group
problem_markdown: Tracker item 0i remains incomplete: callers cannot emit a program from compiled local bundles through the file-only command. The runtime manifest describes the whole implementation closure, so a package name alone cannot establish that the requested main belongs to the selected root group. Reusing nominal Main recognition without inspecting the supplied Main/Prog definitions could also authorize an incompatible native call. Program emission must therefore add explicit root-bundle selection, reuse the existing last-matching-main discovery, enforce the native representation contract, and retain the existing binding, header, determinism, and publication guarantees.

steps.description_markdown:
Extend `core/src/main/scala/dev/bosatsu/tool_command/EmitCCommand.scala` with a typed selector representing either tests from one bundle or a program from one bundle and package. Validate against the loaded implementations before tree shaking; a nominal Main value alone is insufficient.

Tree-shake program generation from only the selected binding and invoke the new explicit-resolver renderMain overload. Factor the repeated generation work narrowly so both modes use the same filtered external resolver, missing-native-binding diagnostics, requested-header generation, and `Output.TranspileOut` construction. Keep the existing all-or-nothing output preparation and the `FileCommandRunner`/`StagedOutputs` publisher; add no direct publication or native-process execution.
